milestone.title: Reverse-engineered → Fully cross-platform WASM canvas
milestone.description:
Reimplement the recovered supported preview contract as a fully portable WASM-based, hot-reloadable developer canvas for Apple app development.

Product compilation/compatibility source, WASM runtime, Rust core, layout/rendering and canvas execution must be portable. No silent fallback to Apple frameworks, Mach, Xcode or simulator execution. Native Apple tools are validation oracles. Complete coverage is measured against the declared recovered contract; unsupported features stay explicit until implemented.

Completion gates:
- [ ] Define source/features/platforms and prove compiler/runtime feasibility on a non-Apple host.
- [ ] Version portable protocol/ABI and implement Rust core, build adapter and bounded WASM host imports/runtime.
- [ ] Implement the declared layout/rendering/assets/fonts/state subset and source-to-image CLI.
- [ ] Deliver developer canvas with transactional hot reload, incremental cache identities, state preservation/reset policy and stale-frame rejection.
- [ ] Pass independent native/candidate corpus, holdouts and injected failure controls.
- [ ] Validate Linux/macOS/Windows and browser execution claims on actual targets.
- [ ] Measure equivalent native/portable cold-start and edit-to-frame p50/p95, CPU and memory; demonstrate cheaper operation for the claimed workloads.
- [ ] Deliver preview-facing MCP, demanded consumer bindings, isolation/cleanup, reproducible packaging and truthful feature/platform matrix.

Early feasibility work may run before the RE milestone closes. Final conformance depends on accepted native references. Compiler/backend/runtime choices remain evidence-driven; do not assume native SwiftUI SDK code becomes WASM through a target flag.

Plan: https://github.com/aspauldingcode/xcpreviewer-rs/blob/development/docs/remaining-work.md
Verification: https://github.com/aspauldingcode/xcpreviewer-rs/blob/development/docs/reverse-engineering/verification.md

milestone.title: 0 → Reverse-engineered
milestone.description:
Recover and verify the Xcode preview contract before declaring reverse engineering complete.

Current verified baseline: checkpoint 3e91d33; 20 RE adapters, 19 research MCP tools, 67 tests. Plist/raw-coder and owned CPU IOSurface handoff controls pass. Native canvas remains blank, Xcode tool discovery stalls, and complete native request/reply coverage is missing.

Completion gates:
- [ ] Reconcile target identities and historical evidence.
- [ ] Obtain stable native A/A and controlled A/B output with declared capture scope.
- [ ] Capture one complete preview lifecycle with correlated envelopes, replies and attachments.
- [ ] Recover required field/discriminant/version/error/cancellation/ordering semantics for the declared platform/output matrix.
- [ ] Verify receiver/sender exit, release accounting, reuse/completion and applicable format/synchronization behavior.
- [ ] Implement native decoder/replay against frozen references and independent negative controls.
- [ ] Publish versioned protocol specification, coverage denominator and remaining unknowns.

Toolkit completion alone does not close this milestone. Raw Apple binaries/private captures remain local; publish sanitized evidence and owned goldens.
